title: Project & Creative Operations Lead
description:
**About TripleDart**
--------------------

TripleDart Digital is an AI-native, full-funnel growth agency built for B2B SaaS. We run paid media, ABM, SEO/GEO, creative, web/CRO and RevOps for 100+ SaaS brands scaling from $5M to $100M+ ARR across the US, Europe and APAC. Clients measure us on qualified pipeline and revenue influenced, and we hold Google Premier, HubSpot Platinum and LinkedIn Corporate Partner status.

Our paid media and ABM programs generate a steady stream of creative work — ad concepts, static and video assets, landing pages, ABM personalization, reporting dashboards. Delivering that at scale, to a US client's expectations, is an operations problem. This role owns it.

**Role Summary**
----------------

You are accountable for the entire paid media and creative operations layer: intake, scoping, scheduling, capacity, SLAs, QC and delivery across the portfolio. Account managers own the client relationship and strategy; you own that what we committed gets built correctly and ships on time.

This is a run-the-system-and-make-it-better role. You've managed delivery at scale before, you know what a healthy ClickUp board looks like, and you don't wait for a miss to find out a process is broken.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

### **Project management across the portfolio**

* Own intake to delivery for every paid media, ABM and creative request across ~15 accounts: scoping, briefs, estimates, scheduling, dependencies and sign-off.
* Run the weekly delivery rhythm — sprint planning, daily stand-ups with pods and creative, and a Friday portfolio review of what shipped, what slipped and why.
* Maintain a single, current view of every account's open work, due dates and blockers that an account manager or founder can read in 30 seconds.

### **SLAs and quality control**

* Define and enforce SLAs by deliverable type (ad copy, statics, video, landing pages, dashboards, campaign builds) and report adherence weekly.
* Build and run the QC layer: checklists, review gates and sign-off before anything reaches a client. Brand, copy, spec, tracking and link checks are non-negotiable.
* Track rework and client-reported misses as a defect rate, root-cause them and close the loop with the function that caused them.

### **Creative operations**

* Own the creative pipeline end to end: briefing standards, asset specs per channel (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, CTV), versioning, approvals and asset handoff to paid media.
* Balance load across copy, design, video and web/dev; forecast creative demand from the media plan and staff or reprioritise ahead of the crunch.
* Maintain the creative library, naming conventions and templates so nothing ships off-brand or off-spec.

### **Capacity planning and ClickUp hygiene**

* ClickUp is the source of truth and you keep it that way: every task scoped, owned, estimated, dated and in the right status. No work outside the system.
* Run capacity planning per pod and per function against the retainer scope; flag over-servicing and under-utilisation to leadership monthly.
* Own time-tracking discipline and the utilisation and SLA dashboards leadership uses to run the BU.

### **Client communication**

* Be the delivery voice on client accounts alongside the account manager: status updates, timelines, revision rounds and expectation-setting on what ships when.
* Handle client-facing delivery escalations directly and proactively — before the client raises them.

### **Cross-functional problem solving**

* Sit between account management, paid media pods, copy, design, dev and analytics. When something is stuck, you unblock it, and you fix the process so it doesn't stick again.
* Document and improve SOPs for recurring work; bring AI and automation (ClickUp automations, n8n, Claude) into intake, QC and reporting to cut manual effort.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

Delivery is under control when the client never has to ask where something is.

KPI

Target

What it measures

  

On-time delivery

95%+ of deliverables shipped by committed date

Scheduling and dependency control across the portfolio

  

SLA adherence

95%+ by deliverable type, reported weekly

Turnaround commitments kept per account

  

QC pass rate

98%+ first-pass; zero client-reported brand, spec or tracking errors

Quality gates working before work reaches the client

  

Rework rate

Under 10% of creative deliverables needing a second revision round

Briefing quality and QC discipline

  

ClickUp hygiene

100% of active work scoped, owned, estimated and dated; weekly audit score

The system reflects reality

  

Capacity utilisation

Pods and creative functions within 90–95% planned utilisation; over-servicing flagged monthly

Retainer scope matched to effort

  

Client delivery satisfaction

4.5+ / 5 on delivery and communication in QBR feedback

Clients trust the process, not just the people

  

Process improvement

At least one SOP or automation shipped per month with measured time saved

The system gets better, not just maintained

Targets are reviewed quarterly with the Head of Paid Media and feed the BU's business review.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Non-negotiables**

* 5–8 years in project, delivery or operations management, with at least 3 years running delivery at scale — 10+ concurrent client accounts or 50+ live deliverables a month — at a marketing agency, creative studio or SaaS marketing team.
* A recognized PM certification: PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, CSM/PSM or equivalent. Google Project Management or ClickUp certifications are a plus on top, not a substitute.
* Expert in ClickUp or an equivalent (Asana, Monday, Jira) — you've designed the workspace, the custom fields, the automations and the dashboards, not just used them.
* Hands-on experience running creative operations: briefing, asset specs across paid channels, review and approval cycles, and managing designers, copywriters and video editors' load.
* Working knowledge of paid media and ABM delivery — what a campaign build, a landing page or a reporting dashboard needs before it can ship — enough to QC it and estimate it.
* Accountability as a reflex. You have owned delivery outcomes personally, carried the miss, and fixed the process after.
* Clear, direct written and spoken English; you write client status updates and run calls with US stakeholders.
* Comfortable with US-overlap hours (2:00–11:00 PM IST) and a fully remote, cross-functional team.

### **Strong plusses**

* Six Sigma, Lean or ITIL exposure; you think in defect rates and cycle times.
* Experience with capacity planning and utilisation reporting against retainer scopes.
* Familiarity with Figma, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4 and Looker Studio.
* Experience building ClickUp or n8n automations, or using Claude/ChatGPT to speed up intake, QC and reporting.
* Prior ownership of SOP libraries, onboarding playbooks or delivery handbooks.

### **How you work**

You are organized to the point of being predictable, and the team relies on that. You communicate early, especially bad news. You solve the problem in front of you and then remove the cause. You hold a standard without needing to be the loudest person on the call.

**Why join us**
---------------

* **Own the whole system.** Paid media and creative operations across the portfolio report into you — not a slice of one account.
* **Scale that matters.** 15 accounts, six delivery pods and a creative team shipping for US SaaS brands scaling to $100M+ ARR.
* **Build with AI.** We use Claude, n8n and ClickUp automations in delivery today; you'll have the mandate and budget to push that further.
* **A direct line to leadership.** You report to the Co-Founder running the BU; your dashboards are the ones the business is run on.
* **A clear path.** This role grows into Head of Delivery / Operations as the BU scales.

**Working setup and benefits**
------------------------------

* Fully remote. Work from anywhere in India.
* Fixed US-overlap shift: 2:00–11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday, so you cover the India afternoon handoff and the full US morning.
* Learning and development budget — PM and platform certifications, courses and conferences.
* Full access to TripleDart's AI-native tooling stack (Claude, ChatGPT, ClickUp, n8n and internal platforms).
* Health insurance and wellbeing support [confirm plan details with HR].

**How to apply**
----------------

**Apply through Keka, or email your resume and cover letter to mailto:sabari@tripledart.com.**

title: Project Manager

title: Global Project Support Analyst
description:
**Location:** India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Remote

**About the Client**

Our client is a sustainability-focused organisation that partners with businesses, governments, and other stakeholders to design and deliver initiatives that create measurable environmental and social impact. The organisation is committed to advancing sustainability outcomes through robust data management, transparent reporting, effective project execution, and strong governance practices. By combining strategic oversight with performance measurement, it helps ensure that sustainability programmes achieve their objectives, demonstrate accountability, and drive long-term value for stakeholders.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical **Global Project Support Analyst** to support global projects through data validation, reporting, dashboard management, and project coordination.

The role involves validating project data, maintaining accurate databases, preparing executive-level reports, and tracking project milestones, payments, and approvals. The ideal candidate will have experience in audit, assurance, or internal controls, strong analytical skills, and proficiency in Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and MS Project.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Validation and Database Integrity**

* Review, cross-check, and validate data submitted by project teams to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across master databases and working files.
* Validate impact metrics and supporting evidence against established reporting standards and documentation requirements.
* Maintain structured Excel workbooks, including formula accuracy, version control, and organised SharePoint documentation.
* Identify data discrepancies and gaps, coordinate with stakeholders for resolution, and maintain validation records.
* Develop and maintain Gantt charts in MS Project to track project timelines, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables.
* Monitor deadlines, milestone payments, approvals, and project risks; follow up with relevant stakeholders and escalate potential delays.
* Identify opportunities to improve data validation processes and introduce automation where appropriate.

**2. Dashboards and Executive Presentations**

* Collect, consolidate, analyse, and verify information from multiple sources to prepare accurate reports.
* Build, maintain, and update Power BI dashboards to support project tracking and performance analysis.
* Prepare and review executive-ready PowerPoint presentations, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and consistency across reports and databases.
* Support project steering committee meetings, project reviews, governing council meetings, and leadership discussions.
* Coordinate project advisory group meetings, including presentation materials, meeting minutes, action items, and timely circulation of documentation.
* Support reporting on project performance and sustainability impact metrics.

**3. Project Management Support**

* Provide day-to-day project coordination support to Project Managers, tracking milestones, deliverables, approvals, and payments.
* Assist in preparing project documentation, including change requests, executive summaries, and closure reports, ensuring completeness and compliance with established processes.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, project leaders, and funding recipients to obtain missing information, resolve documentation gaps, and maintain project progress.
* Review invoices and deliverables, initiate disbursement requests, and help resolve issues related to Microsoft Business Central.
* Support project pipeline documentation, internal and external audits, data analysis, and site visits as required.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Project Management, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in data validation, audit, assurance, reporting, or project coordination.
* Prior experience in audit, assurance, internal controls, or compliance is strongly preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and hands-on experience with Power BI dashboard development and maintenance.
* Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare polished, executive-ready presentations.
* Experience with MS Project or equivalent Gantt-chart tools and familiarity with SharePoint.
* Exposure to invoice processing, project documentation, or Microsoft Business Central is an advantage.

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Audit-oriented mindset with the ability to identify discrepancies and validate supporting evidence.
* Excellent data management, reporting, and presentation skills.
* Strong project coordination, deadline management, and follow-up capabilities.
* Effective stakeholder communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

IntelliPlan

What you will bring to the team:

* Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field.
* PMP, ITIL Certification or equivalent preferred.

* 10+ years of experience in program/ project management, process engineering or strategy within a technology or operations environment
* Experience in Supply Chain and Inventory Management is preferable
* Leadership skills: must have experience leading multiple projects and teams simultaneously
* Problem-solving skills: must be able to identify risks and develop actionable mitigation plans
* Analytical skills: must be highly analytical with experience in using objective data to drive strategic recommendations
* Communications skills: must be able to concisely explain complex issues, communicate well in writing and verbally, and be able to build strong working relationships across all levels of the organization, including remote areas
* Intellectual curiosity: must possess a desire to understand why/how things work vs. simply completing the task at hand
* Knowledge of and experience using Project Management Software
* Possesses strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.

While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.

At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!

description:

title: Program Manager, AI Data Ops
description:
**About AiDASH**  

  

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.



The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.



Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

#### **The Role**



AiDASH is looking for a high\-agency Program Manager to help scale our AI Data Ops function: the team responsible for sourcing, processing, and annotating the satellite and remote sensing imagery that powers our AI/ML models.



This role is a new addition to the leadership team, created specifically to bring an **automation\-first, numbers\-backed, process\-driven** operating model to how Ops runs . This role is designed to reduce operational complexity over time, not to manage individual queues or projects indefinitely. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, vendor management, and data science delivery, helping AI Data Ops evolve from a fast\-scaling function into a well\-designed, repeatable operating system.



You will need to zoom in to solve real problems on the ground — a stuck vendor SLA, a high priority escalation, a broken handoff — and zoom out to design the processes, playbooks, and automation that stop the same problems from recurring.  

  

This is a high\-visibility, build\-from\-scratch role: you'll be judged on the systems and habits you install, not just the projects you close.

#### **How** **You'll** **Make an Impact:**


**Automation \& AI\-native ways of working**


* Identify repetitive, manual workflows across annotation, QA, imagery processing and reporting, and drive their automation — via internal tooling, scripting, RPA, or AI\-assisted workflows.
* Build and own the automation roadmap and drive it seamlessly across the team


**Program \& project management**


* Run structured program governance (milestones, RAID logs, status cadence) across cross\-functional initiatives that no single manager owns end\-to\-end.
* Bring discipline — timelines, ownership, dependencies — to all team initiatives


**Cost reduction**


* Own a cost\-efficiency roadmap for Ops: vendor spend, tooling spends, rework/error costs, and capacity utilization.
* Build the business case and track savings with real numbers\- Clear visible impact


**Vendor performance frameworks**


* Design and own scorecards/SLAs for imagery, annotation and other third\-party vendors.
* Run regular vendor performance reviews and own escalation/renewal/replacement decisions in partnership with managers.


**Cross\-functional ownership \& data ownership**


* Serve as the connective tissue across all managers and leads — surfacing shared problems (tooling, process, vendor etc) that no single manager can fix alone.
* Own org\-wide SOP creation and the dashboard/metrics layer (throughput, quality, SLA, utilization) so every manager works off the same numbers.


**Enable leadership with insight and structure**


* Build dashboards/reports tracking throughput, accuracy, vendor performance, and cost efficiency; define KPIs that drive decisions on quality, capacity, and cost
* Manage budgets across data sourcing, annotation ops, and vendor contracts, identifying cost\-optimization opportunities
* Translate ambiguous problems into structured, actionable plans


#### **What We're Looking For:**


* 5\+ years of experience spanning program/project management, business operations, or management consulting — ideally with exposure to automation, Ops, vendor management and cost optimization.
* A genuine track record of building metrics/automation programs from scratch — not just running ones someone else designed.
* Comfort with data: you should be able to build and defend a dashboard or a business case yourself, not just commission one.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the face of Ops in external conversations.
* Experience managing external vendors/partners and negotiating SLAs.
* Bonus: prior exposure to GIS, geospatial, imagery, or annotation\-heavy operations; experience standing up automation/RPA/AI tooling programs (This is not mandatory)
* Must\-have: hands\-on experience working in a startup environment.


We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.

#### 


We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

**Role Overview**



The Coupang Intelligent Cloud (CIC) organization is building the next\-generation cloud platform that powers Coupang's rapidly expanding business. CIC provides the foundational infrastructure, cloud services, platform capabilities, and operational excellence that enable engineering teams across the company to innovate at scale.



As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will drive large\-scale, cross\-functional initiatives spanning cloud infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, AI infrastructure, platform services, operational excellence, reliability, capacity management, and cloud business growth. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, principal engineers, product leaders, finance, security, and operations teams to define strategy, build execution plans, and deliver business\-critical outcomes.



This role requires a unique combination of technical depth, organizational leadership, operational rigor, and strategic thinking. You will lead complex programs that influence the direction of CIC, establish scalable operating mechanisms, and ensure alignment across multiple organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership while driving execution with urgency and accountability.



The ideal candidate can speak the language of engineers, understand large\-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, influence without authority, and navigate ambiguity while delivering measurable results.


**What You Will Do**


* Lead strategic, organization\-wide programs across cloud infrastructure, platform services, AI infrastructure, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Define program strategies, success metrics, execution frameworks, and operating mechanisms that scale across the CIC organization.
* Partner with engineering leaders and principal engineers to prioritize investments, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of critical initiatives.
* Drive large\-scale platform transformations involving architecture modernization, reliability improvements, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Establish governance mechanisms, executive reviews, risk management processes, and business reporting frameworks.
* Identify organizational bottlenecks, process inefficiencies, and system gaps, and implement scalable solutions to improve execution.
* Lead initiatives involving infrastructure scalability, cloud adoption, capacity planning, service availability, and operational readiness.
* Analyze complex technical and business data to drive prioritization, decision\-making, and resource allocation.
* Define and track organizational KPIs, operational health metrics, reliability goals, and business outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, security, finance, procurement, and business teams to achieve company objectives.
* Drive executive\-level communications, presenting program status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Mentor TPMs and contribute to the growth of program management excellence within CIC.


**Basic Qualifications**


* 12\+ years of experience leading large\-scale technical programs in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or related technology domains.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, storage, compute platforms, and modern software development practices.
* Experience driving programs across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through deployment and operational support.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage metrics and data to influence decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience identifying root causes, managing risks, and solving complex organizational and technical challenges.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working in hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, AI infrastructure, or large\-scale distributed systems environments.
* Strong technical understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, cloud\-native architectures, and infrastructure automation.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure programs involving compute, networking, storage, observability, security, or AI/ML platforms.
* Experience partnering with Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders to drive architecture and platform transformation initiatives.
